Laravel Composer library `pepperfm/api-responder-for-laravel` (branch `3.x`): standardized API JSON responses via DI/Facade. Not a Laravel application; classes are in `Pepperfm\ApiBaseResponder` under `src/`.

Commands:
`vendor/bin/pest --filter="test name"`
`vendor/bin/pest tests/Unit/ApiBaseResponderTest.php`
`composer lint-hard`

`declare(strict_types=1)` is required in every PHP file (enforced by Pint). Pint preset/custom rules: `pint.json`. Class/function braces next line; control-structure braces same line; closure spacing `fn()`; no import ordering; `not_operator_with_successor_space`: false (`!$var`); native types preferred over PHPDoc (`phpdoc_to_property_type`, `phpdoc_to_return_type` enabled).

Direct API: `ApiBaseResponder::response()`, `stored()`, `deleted()` resolve keys via config/private `buildJsonResponse()`. No `debug_backtrace()`.
Builder API: `build()` blank builder; `forMethod('show')` sets REST context; `withDataKey('users')` sets key; `fromAction()` reads calling-method PHP attributes (opt-in minimal backtrace). `ResponseBuilder` key priority: explicit `withDataKey()` > `#[ResponseDataKey]` via `fromAction()` > REST convention (`show`/`update` singular, others plural) > `laravel-api-responder.plural_data_key`.
